I have farmed this land since I was a girl helping my mother. Last season I received a government fertilizer coupon and shared the bag with my sister's husband because one bag is too much for my small plot — I put about two basinfuls on this plot, and the maize grew better than the field without. I will do the same this season if the coupons come. I also carried three baskets of manure from our cattle kraal because this land belongs to my family and I want it to stay good. I will plant the hybrid seed that came with the coupon — the cobs were big last year. I do not use sprays, that is for tobacco. I wait for the rains, I have no way to water. I will work this plot with my children, about twenty days from start to finish. I have no money to hire anyone.
